name: Haiku small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Biotech-led healthcare pivot combining sector rotation (biotech/banks) with small-cap diversification and semi-cycle mean-reversion, hedged by crypto shorts for carry income
novelty: This strategy pivots from previous tech-heavy approaches to a cross-sector momentum play anchored in biotech's +82.7% 12-month outperformance and financial sector recovery. Unlike Rounds 1-2 (pure growth/concentrated tech leverage), this combines three distinct edges: (1) healthcare momentum rotation away from tech saturation, (2) small-cap breadth for diversification vs mega-cap risk, (3) semi-cycle mean-reversion on oversold weakness. Crypto shorts fund carry income (10% APR perp funding) while providing systematic hedges.

positions.thesis: Biotech momentum (+14.6% 1m, +82.7% 12m); healthcare sector rotation away from tech saturation; strong tailwinds in AI-driven drug discovery and emerging therapies
Regional bank recovery (+26.5% 12m); financial sector rotation supporting mean-reversion cycle; stable deposit base and net interest margin expansion
Small-cap Russell 2000 breadth exposure (+36.6% 12m); diversifies from mega-cap tech concentration; mid-cycle strength in economically sensitive names
3x leveraged semiconductor mean-reversion; beaten down 1m (-8.7% SMH, -39.2% SOXL) but +103.8% 12m structural support indicates cycle bottom; leverage amplifies rebound
Japan equity outperformance (+36% 12m) on structural reforms and yen weakness; international diversification outside US tech cycles
Consumer staples momentum fade; weak +7.1% 12m vs +22.7% market; defensive rotation losing in growth-positive environment
Crypto bear market continuation (-46% 12m); short perp generates 10% APR funding yield on long exposure; hedges tech concentration while earning carry; liquidation risk managed at 95%

outlook: Market environment supports sector rotation into biotech (+14.6% recent momentum) and banks as mega-cap tech faces margin pressure after 12-month +41.5% XLK run. Small-cap strength (IWM +36.6% 12m) remains intact with economic resilience. Crypto bear market (-46% 12m) likely continues through Q3, supporting short funding yields. Semiconductor cycle positioning (SOXL 3x) captures mean-reversion on excessive 1-month weakness (-39.2% SOXL) despite +103.8% 12m structural support indicating cycle inflection. Daily stop-losses enforce discipline across sector rotation volatility. Positioning for 12-16% NAV growth through 2026-12-31.
